leadText: Like the Wind (Korean: 바람처럼 Baramcheoreom) is the ending theme for the 2012 Korean redubbing of Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back. It is performed by Do Yunsuk. It was also used as an insert song for the Korean dub of SM021.
plainText:
Like the Wind (Korean: 바람처럼 Baramcheoreom) is the ending theme for the 2012 Korean redubbing of Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back. It is performed by Do Yunsuk. It was also used as an insert song for the Korean dub of SM021.

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

 

 
 
 

 

 
 
 

 

 
 

I stopped and looked at the sky. I'm going to reach as high as that 

Lots of people in the world, you meet them and leave them
I'll fly to the end, just like the wind which doesn't rest when tired
To find that dream eternally inside my heart 

I stopped and looked at the sky. I'm going to reach as high as that 

Lots of people in the world, you meet them and leave them
I'll fly to the end, just like the wind which doesn't rest when tired
To find that dream eternally inside my heart 

Wherever it is, if we walk together, I can see your glistening eyes. Woah~

I'll fly to the end, just like the wind which doesn't rest when tired
To find that dream eternally inside my heart 
 

 
 
 

zh:寶可夢電影 韓語片尾曲1重配
